_about: Settings every screen shares. Edit this file on GitHub and each screen picks it up at its next fresh start (03:30 by default). It's published with the site, so keep anything private out of it: no address, and the calendar address is set on each screen instead. Bins: one known collection date and how many weeks between collections; the weekly council check moves these on when Stockport changes a date. Any screen can still override these in its own settings.
